text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text:
—All right! Tire pull sprint, last 3 sets! 
You ready?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Yes! Not yet!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, in the academy track stands— 
Chairwoman Akikawa was quietly watching 
over the students working hard on their 
training.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh! You! You are always working so 
hard alongside the students!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Your team, in particular, has made 
tremendous contributions to the academy's 
nutrition up to now."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Truly admirable! Belated though it may be, 
allow me as Chairwoman to offer my thanks! 
Those like you are the true pillars of 
this Academy!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
No, no. I merely provided the spark. You 
all eagerly learned on your own, 
accumulating knowledge and experience.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"...I only opened up the fields hoping it 
might contribute, even slightly, to the 
students' health—"

text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text:
—Tomorrow's finally the big day. Think you 
can do it?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...You can do it. After all, haven't you 
been preparing for this day all along?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
The old me... who was always injured, 
quick to despair, and gave up on 
everything, is gone.

text_block_list.name: Trainer
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. You've changed.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
That day feels like so long ago now. The 
day the two of us first drove a hoe into 
the field.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I used to think it was ridiculous. Like... 
how could mere food change anything?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Still, I grew it myself, so I felt I had 
to eat it... and I ended up eating the 
supplemental meals Trainer planned out 
every day too.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"...I realized things can change. My bones 
got stronger, my muscles transformed 
completely, and I became able to race in 
top condition."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
My life has changed... and my heart has 
changed too. I realized that as long as I 
don't give up, I can definitely seize my 
dreams.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Tomorrow... I intend to go and prove it.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ………… Umu... umu.
choice_data_list:
...I'm glad we opened up the fields, 
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. A student was saved. If only for 
that, I—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"...However, I must do more. If food can 
bring salvation to students, then I want 
to expand that circle even further."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...... Truth be told, I have an idea I've 
been mulling over. I should have a chance 
to share it with you soon.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then, some days later—the field is 
bustling with many students as usual. 
There—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? Everyone, the Chairwoman is here! 
Hey! Good afternoon!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hello~! Chairwomaaan!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Indeed! Excellent work, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Today... I have a favor to ask of 
everyone! Do you remember our previous 
presentation?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Ever since then, the number of 
girls coming to the field has shot way up!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It just goes to show how much more 
everyone has started thinking about food, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, precisely! Therefore— I am currently 
planning to hold an event on an even 
grander scale than that!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
An event that involves the entire school, 
across all grades, serving as the 
culmination of everything so far—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
We shall call it—the 'Tracers Bountiful 
Harvest Festival'!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Food! And the knowledge surrounding it! I 
want to provide a place that offers both 
in the finest form to our students!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
And—I believe nothing other than the 
ingredients you grew would be fit to serve 
there!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"With the Chairwoman directly involved, 
across the whole academy— this looks like 
it will be quite the event."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El-El's super-spicy cooking is breathing 
fire! I'll grow hot chili peppers and join 
the fray, deeeesu!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"I've made so many new dishes since the 
showcase... If I polish them even more, do 
you think they'll be dishes that surprise 
everyone...?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: S-Somehow, I'm getting really excited...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, indeed...! I might be busy for a 
while preparing to host it, but as long as 
time permits, I intend to help out in the 
fields as well!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Let's all sweat together... and do our 
best!
